provenance.runList: The field names of one entry of `gh run list --json databaseId,headSha,createdAt,event,status,conclusion,url,displayTitle,headBranch`: the JSON FIELDS section of `gh run list --help`, read on 2026-11-25. The values are placeholders.
provenance.runStatus: The fields status, conclusion, html_url and head_sha of `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>`, as tools/wait-release.mjs reads them.
